title: Rock the Promise Gently
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Long, long ago a promise came
Before the baby's birth;
"Unto us a child will be born!"
Isaiah told the earth.

[Chorus]
So rock your arms and whisper low,
"The Prince of Peace will come";
The promise that our Father made
Is kept for everyone.

[Verse 2]
He would be wonderful and kind,
A helper strong and true;
A mighty, loving Prince of Peace
To show the way home, too.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
That baby's name was Jesus Christ,
Heavenly Father's Son;
Told of so long before He came,
So hope had long begun.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
So close your eyes, my little one,
And hold the promise tight;
He always keeps His promises —
His peace is here tonight.

[Chorus]
mood: Waiting music. A slow rocking figure in three under the voice, the unhurried sway of arms holding something precious long before it arrives. A music box turns the tune over in small glockenspiel notes, one strand at a time, with a soft low warmth beneath that keeps the count while the song waits. It begins hushed and expectant and comes to rest in the arms rather than resolving, so the last line feels like a promise already being held.
